summary: Engineering maintenance: timestamp TTL and bounded counter conversion, atomic archive history, stable cursors, shared AI model configuration, batched task reads, CI lint/components/dependency automation and evergreen module skills.

api.reason: Archive writes one atomic timeline transition while repeated current-version archive requests remain no-ops. Pagination security and task scope remain unchanged. No new endpoint or permission.
api.permissions: Existing Google/App Check, active membership, recipient-only tasks and leads:archive PAT scope are unchanged; batch reads still filter current lead access.

metrics.reason: Bounded CI lint/components labels join existing outcome/duration reporting; no customer or case identifiers become metric dimensions.

traces.reason: One value-free firestore.getAll dependency span replaces per-task document RPCs; existing request and worker spans remain.

logs.reason: Bounded legacy counter conversion emits numeric counts and completion only. Test errors, DOM snapshots and private values stay local.

businessEvents.reason: Archive activity reuses atomic domain outboxes. Vitest emits hashed leaf-case outcomes through existing trusted CI event transport, separate from customer business events.

deploymentEvents.reason: Existing deployment signal transport and exact-version/SHA verification remain. SDLC transport and tenant bucket changes are separate issue #71.

manualVerification: No visible UI layout or workflow changes: frontend edits remove unused imports/functions and use const, while synthetic component tests exercise existing controls. Preserve honestly versioned public captures. Real demo Auth/Firestore/Storage tests verify timestamp conversion, task queries and transactions; managed TTL deletion timing, physical-device/Safari behavior, live customer writes and tenant searchability are separate evidence. #36 remains pending a matching-semantics decision and is not claimed by this plan.
